title: Ringo and Maureen fly from Las Vegas to Los Angeles
content:
Following their meeting with Elvis Presley in Las Vegas, Ringo Starr and his wife Maureen Starkey returned to Los Angeles on this day.

They had arrived in LA on 26 January to attend the US premiere of The Magic Christian, which starred Ringo.

This was a short stop in the city. The following day they flew to New York, returning to England the day after.

Page last updated: 19 January 2016
